subject: Request: Budget evaluation and walkthrough
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@bluemosa.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Budget evaluation & quick walkthrough request

Hi Markus,

I filled out the form on your pricing page earlier today — Bluemosa is evaluating inference providers and we have a budget range of roughly $50k–$100k ARR for this project. I’m the engineering lead and would like a short walkthrough focused on:

- latency and deployment options (VPC/on-prem)
- predictable cost controls (batching/quantization)
- how rollouts / model pinning work for production

We’re hoping for a 30-minute call next week. My availability is fairly open on Tue/Wed afternoons (PT).

A little context: Bluemosa runs a batch inference pipeline and we’re exploring options to move some features to low-latency online calls. Happy to share a short architecture sketch prior to the call if helpful.

Thanks —
Sam Ortiz
Engineering Lead, Bluemosa Analytics
samantha.ortiz@bluemosa.com

Attachment: bluemosa-arch-sketch.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Budget evaluation & quick walkthrough request

Hi Sam — thanks for the note and the sketch, that’s super helpful. I’m Markus (AE on your account) — glad you found the pricing page.

I can do a 30-minute walkthrough next week and cover the three bullets you mentioned. Quick options (PT):

- Tue Oct 6, 11:00–11:30am PT
- Tue Oct 6, 3:00–3:30pm PT
- Wed Oct 7, 1:30–2:00pm PT

If none of those work, you can also pick a slot directly: https://cal.com/redwood/30min?ref=pricing-form

I’ll attach a one-pager that summarizes our deployment modes and unit-cost levers so you can skim beforehand. On the call we can:
- confirm fit for your latency requirements,
- map an initial cost estimate given your expected token volume, and
- outline a potential pilot timeline.

Monica (cc’d) is our SDR who will help coordinate invites and follow-ups.

Best,
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com

Attachment(s): redwood-pricing-onepager.pdf (PDF)
Calendar: https://cal.com/redwood/30min?ref=pricing-form
